profileEvidence.summary: Initially shy in scent-searching classes, Kari Trotsky’s Pomapoo Levi was finding the target scents by his third lesson. Her memoir records daily walks to new places and a charity cruise on Lake Michigan. Swimming was less appealing: he paddled straight to the pool exit. At home, he barked to keep other dogs off his chosen couch space.
